is_purchases.zh-TW: 本期進貨是這期買進的貨，其中有些可能已經賣掉了。
is_purchases.en: Purchases are the inventories bought this period, some of which may already have been sold.

is_opening_inventory.zh-TW: 期初存貨是期初那一天的存貨，對應的是上一期的資產負債表。
is_opening_inventory.en: Opening inventories are what was held at the start of the period and match last period's balance sheet.

prompt.zh-TW: 日暮文具社的損益表裡，有一列的金額和資產負債表上的「存貨」完全相同。請在損益表上點出那一列。
prompt.en: One line on Sunset Stationery's income statement carries exactly the same amount as "inventories" on the balance sheet. Tap that line on the income statement.

explanation.zh-TW: 期末存貨是這一期結束時還沒賣出的貨。在損益表上它被減掉（因為不是這期的成本），在資產負債表上它是一項資產，兩邊是同一個數字。
explanation.en: Closing inventories are the goods still unsold at the end of the period. On the income statement they are deducted (because they are not this period's cost); on the balance sheet they are an asset. Both show the same figure.
